title: Restore proof
summary: A pending host abort retains custody until cleanup is proven. After stopping a failed runner, its lease holder or a covering steering seat may reset every held host to the interrupted baseline. Only successful same-lease, same-machine reset receipts after cancellation permit normal abort settlement; pre-case heartbeat never marks the next case in flight. Host admission binds the cursor; its subsequent check-in marks host work in flight, while admission alone requires no restoration. Manual baseline proof preserves canonical probes, uses separate destination parents for each capture attempt, and verifies both baseline variants then final fresh-host. Daemon-unreachable is not cleanup evidence; require exact owned labeled resources absent with daemon live, real Compose and readonly bind checks, and applicable network isolation. A failed mission baseline surfaces the failing probe reason and recovery from its receipt, with a generic diagnosis only when the receipt lacks them.
